session_summary.learned: For ORC-42, the user required semicolon-delimited CSV invoice exports because the local accounting importer treats commas as decimal separators. A dry-run preview and rollback procedure are separate requirements; production rollout is blocked pending accounting sign-off. An assistant later reported implementing the exporter and preview and believed the task was production-ready, but provided no verification evidence. The report does not establish that the rollback procedure or accounting sign-off is complete.
session_summary.next_steps: Confirm implementation and verification, and establish whether the rollback procedure and accounting sign-off are complete before treating production rollout as ready.
session_summary.title: ORC-42 export requirements and unverified readiness report
